supersedes: C2GES-NERC-ANNOTATION-PILOT-v1.0 (SHA-256 030AE44ABE53975CB3838FBC898723523C4BEC7BE11A433EDB8654AEA2DC706D); pilot outputs remain archived under runs/c2ges_pilot/ and are NOT reused
governance: Machine-adjudicated SILVER labels only; never human/expert gold. No human review gate in this stage.
reason_for_revision: Pilot (25 items) showed 76% adjudication rate driven by (1) annotator B including background/context sentences while A selected minimal sets, and (2) inconsistent answerable thresholds (inference vs explicit statement). v1.1 adds explicit evidence-sufficiency and answerability rules.

task.unit: one role-conditioned question over one NERC event-analysis document
task.input_to_annotators: document sentences with stable sids + question + question role; NO prior labels, NO other annotator output

evidence_sufficiency_rules_v1_1: R1: Select ONLY sentences that directly state the fact the question asks for. A sentence is IN only if removing it makes the answer incomplete.
R2: Exclude scene-setting, background, or restating sentences even if topically related.
R3: Exception to R2: if the question explicitly asks about time/place/quantity and that detail appears only in a separate sentence, include that sentence too.
R4: If several sentences each partially state the fact (e.g. event in one, date in another), include exactly the minimal covering set.
R5: Tie-break: when uncertain whether a borderline sentence is required, EXCLUDE it.

R6 (answerability): answerable=true only if the document EXPLICITLY states the queried fact. If answering requires inference, combining weak scattered mentions, or outside knowledge, set answerable=false and evidence_role=insufficient with empty evidence set.
R7: A document section that merely says a topic is discussed elsewhere does not make the question answerable.
models: unchanged from v1.0 (A=DeepSeek deepseek-chat direct; B=Gemini gemini-2.5-flash direct; C=gpt-5.4 via Cloubic, disagreements only)
prompt_template:
You are annotating evidence for a question about a public NERC power-system event report.

[DOCUMENT {doc_id}: {title}]
{numbered sentences as [sid] text}

[QUESTION id={qid}] ({role}) {question}

Evidence rules:
- Select ONLY sentences that directly state the asked fact; a sentence is in only if removing it makes the answer incomplete.
- Exclude background/scene-setting/restating sentences. Exception: if the question asks time/place/quantity stated only in a separate sentence, include it.
- If several sentences each carry part of the fact, include exactly the minimal covering set.
- When unsure about a borderline sentence, EXCLUDE it.
- answerable=true only if the document EXPLICITLY states the fact; inference or scattered weak mentions => answerable=false, evidence_role=insufficient, empty evidence.
- A section merely saying a topic is discussed elsewhere is not an answer.
Echo the question id in field qid. Return ONLY one JSON object matching this schema: {schema}
adjudication_rule: unchanged from v1.0 (C on disagreements/abstains only, anonymized annotator_1/annotator_2)
validation_gate_before_full_run: Re-annotate 12 pilot items that required adjudication under v1.0, using v1.1 prompts. Proceed to the full 75-question run only if the adjudication rate on these 12 drops to <= 50%; otherwise report back instead of running the full set.
stop_conditions: 5 consecutive auth or format failures for one model -> halt and report
served model id differs from frozen id (DeepSeek rolling alias deepseek-v4-flash excepted) -> halt and report
total stage-2 calls exceed the budget in STAGE2_AUTHORIZATION_20260807.json -> halt
ledger_requirements: unchanged from v1.0; stage-2 outputs go to runs/c2ges_stage2/ and must not overwrite runs/c2ges_pilot/
